Class PartialHistoricalTickRecordCID<T>

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.esignal.jstandard.beans.tick.DefaultHistoricalTickRecord<T>
      • com.esignal.jstandard.beans.tick.DefaultHistoricalTickRecordCID<T>

    public class PartialHistoricalTickRecordCID<T>
extends DefaultHistoricalTickRecordCID<T>
implements HistoricalTickRecordCID<T>
